paper.corr: Hee-Tak Kim（KAIST；LG Energy Solution 合作）
paper.group_note: DME 中加约 20 vol% 氟化醚共溶剂（ETFE < BTFE < TFTFE < TFOFE，按 F 数）逐级减弱 Li⁺ 溶剂化；LiFSI + LiNO3 双盐。40 µm 薄锂（约 8 mAh/cm²）对 3.8 mg/cm² 硫，E/S 5，按 N/P 属负极受限一侧。选行规则（不看结果）：每种 DME-FE 对 DME 对照，取作者报告的全部比较；软包只有 DME-TFTFE 对 DME。失效分析用的是另一基准（1 M LiTFSI + 0.2 M LiNO3 DOL/DME，46 圈：剩余可逆锂 6.3 / 8 mAh/cm²，DME 分解 33%、DOL 49%、TFSI⁻ 2%，补液后恢复），与本表配方对不同、圈数不同，未列行，作为机制证据记在机制判别表。36 圈后剩余活性锂、DME/FSI⁻ 保留率未测 TFOFE

DM.name: DME 对照：0.75 M LiFSI + 0.4 M LiNO3 / DME
DM.label: 强溶剂化
DM.quote: The control electrolyte (DME electrolyte) was prepared by dissolving 0.75 m LiFSI and 0.4 m LiNO3 in DME

ET.name: DME-ETFE（LiFSI:LiNO3:DME:ETFE = 1.9:1.0:18.5:3.8）
ET.label: 适中溶剂化
ET.quote: The electrolytes containing the ﬂuorinated cosolvents were prepared using a molar ratio of LiFSI:LiNO3:DME:cosolvent = 1.9:1.0:18.5:3.8, resulting in a ﬂuorinated solvent volume fraction of ≈20% in the DME-FE electrolyte

descriptors.scale: 电解液 ⁷Li NMR 向高场位移排序（位移越大 = Li⁺ 溶剂化能力越弱）
descriptors.unit: 序号（仅表次序；大=溶剂化强）
descriptors.comparable_note: 同篇同法（Fig. S6、2d）；Raman CIP 比例、电导率、⁷Li DOSY、MD 配位数、Kamlet–Taft 碱度均同序
descriptors.quote: The 7Li NMR analysis of the electrolytes revealed that the upﬁeld shifts corresponding to Li+ increased in the following order: DME < DME-ETFE < DME-BTFE < DME-TFTFE < DME-TFOFE (Figure S6, Supporting Information), indicating that the Li+ solvating powers decreased in the same order

descriptors.scale: Li2S4 最大溶解度（UV–vis，电解液中）排序
descriptors.unit: 序号（仅表次序；大=溶解多）
descriptors.comparable_note: 同篇同法（Fig. S16），数值只在图中；0.2 M Li2S4 的颜色与 ⁷Li 位移同序
descriptors.conc_def: 名义 0.5 M Li2S4 饱和
descriptors.quote: The results indicated that the maximum Li2S4 solubility was found to follow the order: DME > DME-ETFE > DME-BTFE > DME-TFTFE > DME-TFOFE which is consistent with our NMR data

C1.desc: Li‖S 扣式（3.8 mg/cm²、E/S 5、40 µm Li、0.15C；0.05C×2、0.1C 预循环）
C1.cathode_material: LG Energy Solution 高载量硫正极（Φ14 mm）
C1.quote: a high S-loaded electrode (3.8 mgs cm−2) obtained from LG Energy Solution Ltd. was used, a Φ14-mm sulfur cathode was used as the working cathode, and Φ16-mm Li metal (40 μm, China Lithium) was used as the counter electrode. Furthermore, 29.4 μL of electrolyte was injected to adjust the E/S ratio to 5 μL mgs−1

C2.desc: Li‖Ni Aurbach 法（40 µm Li，30 µL；1 mAh/cm² 储锂后 0.2 mAh/cm² × 10，1 mA/cm²）
C2.quote: The amount of injected electrolyte was 30 μL. First, 1 mAh cm−2 of Li deposit was formed on the Ni foil at 1 mA cm−2, and subsequently, ten cycles of repetitive strip and plate were conducted at the same current density and a 0.2 mAh cm−2 capacity

C3.desc: Li‖Ni 长循环（0.2 mA/cm²、0.2 mAh/cm²、15 µL，100 圈平均 CE）
C3.quote: comparing the Coulombic eﬃciencies of the Li/Ni asymmetric cell operated at 0.2 mA cm−2 with a capacity of 0.2 mAh cm−2 using 15 μL of each electrolyte

C4.desc: 双面正极 bi-cell 软包（2.5 mg/cm² 每面、E/S 3.5、40 µm Li、0.1C）
C4.cathode_material: LG Energy Solution 双面涂布硫正极
C4.quote: To assemble the bi-cell-type pouch cell, 40μm-thick Li foil was cut into 4 × 6 cm2 pieces … Then, 336 μL of electrolyte was injected to adjust the E/S ratio to 3.5

C5.desc: 0.5 Ah 叠片软包（10 层，E/S 2.0、0.05C；锂厚未写）
C5.cathode_material: LG Energy Solution 双面涂布硫正极（2.5 mg/cm² 每面）
C5.S_loading_src: 直接（每面；按同一批正极推定）
C5.quote: The volume of electrolyte corresponding to an E/S ratio of 2 was 0.825 mL

comparisons.quote: The DME-ETFE, DME-BTFE, and DME-TFTFE electrolytes displayed slightly higher overpotentials than and similar discharge capacities as the DME electrolyte
comparisons.note: 对照按 0.75 M 配，DME-FE 按摩尔比配，盐与 DME 的比例不同

comparisons.quote: The DME-ETFE, DME-BTFE, and DME-TFTFE electrolytes displayed slightly higher overpotentials than and similar discharge capacities as the DME electrolyte

comparisons.unit: µA（95% 充电态开路穿梭电流）
comparisons.author_judgement: 穿梭电流与多硫化物溶解度一致；TFOFE 略高于 MSE，归因于低电荷密度单阴离子更易在负极还原
comparisons.quote: The PS shuttle current detected in a 95% charged cell under open-circuit voltage[27] was found to decrease in the following order: DME > weakly solvating electrolyte (DME-TFOFE) > moderately solvating electrolytes (DME-ETFE, DME-BTFE
comparisons.note: 对照按 0.75 M 配，DME-FE 按摩尔比配，盐与 DME 的比例不同

comparisons.author_judgement: 除 TFOFE 外寿命与负极可逆性强相关
comparisons.quote: The cycle numbers of the DME-TFTFE, DMEBTFE, DME, DME-ETFE, and DME-TFOFE electrolytes at a capacity retention of 70% were 154, 131, 36, 32, and 31 cycles, respectively
comparisons.note: 对照按 0.75 M 配，DME-FE 按摩尔比配，盐与 DME 的比例不同

comparisons.author_judgement: 氟化度越高与锂相容性越好（ETFE 例外，略低于 DME）

comparisons.note: 对照按 0.75 M 配，DME-FE 按摩尔比配，盐与 DME 的比例不同

comparisons.author_judgement: 阴离子配位增强提高负极稳定性
